name: run_id
meaning: The name of the run, mnist_sweep.run_id.
source: mnist_sweep.run_id

name: init_scale
meaning: The initial scale s. The initial weights are multiplied by s. For this 3-homogeneous network the initial output is s^3 and the initial kernel s^4 times its value at s = 1.
source: Liu, Michaud and Tegmark (2023), Omnigrok, arXiv:2210.01117, Section 4

name: width
meaning: The width of both hidden layers.

name: eta_kappa
meaning: The weight decay per step, eta lambda in the report. It is unchanged when the learning rate changes.
source: docs/report.tex, The laziness and weight-decay knobs

name: seed
meaning: The model seed.

name: data_seed
meaning: The seed of the draw of the training images, 42 + seed.

name: step
meaning: The checkpoint step.

name: log10_step1
meaning: Base 10 logarithm of the step plus one.

name: dt_prev
meaning: Steps since the previous checkpoint. NaN at step 0.

name: on_linear_grid
meaning: True if the step is a multiple of the linear checkpoint interval.

name: on_log_grid
meaning: True if the step is one of the log-spaced checkpoints.

name: wall_seconds
meaning: Wall-clock seconds since the run started. It depends on the machine and the load.

name: train_loss
meaning: Mean squared error of the network on the train set.
source: ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: train_acc
meaning: Accuracy of the network on the train set, by the largest output.
source: ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: test_loss
meaning: Mean squared error of the network on the test set.
source: ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: test_acc
meaning: Accuracy of the network on the test set, by the largest output.
source: ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: train_margin_mean
meaning: Mean over the train set of the correct output minus the largest other output.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: train_margin_min
meaning: Smallest margin over the train set.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: train_correct_out_mean
meaning: Mean output at the correct class on the train set. The MSE target there is one.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: train_wrong_out_rms
meaning: Root mean square output at the wrong classes on the train set. The MSE target there is zero.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: train_out_rms
meaning: Root mean square of all outputs on the train set, the output scale.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: train_out_max_mean
meaning: Mean over the train set of the largest output.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: test_margin_mean
meaning: Mean over the test set of the correct output minus the largest other output.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: test_margin_min
meaning: Smallest margin over the test set.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: test_correct_out_mean
meaning: Mean output at the correct class on the test set. The MSE target there is one.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: test_wrong_out_rms
meaning: Root mean square output at the wrong classes on the test set. The MSE target there is zero.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: test_out_rms
meaning: Root mean square of all outputs on the test set, the output scale.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: test_out_max_mean
meaning: Mean over the test set of the largest output.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: lr
meaning: The learning rate in force for the steps after the checkpoint. The curvature rule sets it to eta_0 lam_0 / lam_t every lr_update_interval steps.
source: ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint (eta)

name: lr_factor
meaning: lr over its value at step 0.
source: The group's own definition

name: lam
meaning: The latest top Gauss-Newton eigenvalue of the training loss, from the last update of the learning rate.
source: ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: grad_norm
meaning: Norm of the gradient of the full training loss, without the decay term.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: grad_norm_W1
meaning: Norm of the gradient of the full training loss with respect to W1.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: grad_norm_W2
meaning: Norm of the gradient of the full training loss with respect to W2.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: grad_norm_W3
meaning: Norm of the gradient of the full training loss with respect to W3.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: update_norm
meaning: Norm of a full-batch gradient step with decay at the current learning rate. Training takes minibatch steps, so this is the size of the mean step.
formula: lr ||g + wd theta||, wd = eta_kappa / lr
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: grad_weight_cos
meaning: Cosine between the loss gradient and the weights. Near minus one at a point where decay and gradient cancel.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: grad_decay_ratio
meaning: Size of the loss gradient over the size of the decay pull. NaN without decay.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: decay_residual
meaning: How far the gradient and the decay pull are from cancelling. Zero at a fixed point of gradient descent with decay, one when the two are orthogonal.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: stationary
meaning: True if the run has decay and decay_residual is below 0.001.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: sharpness
meaning: Largest eigenvalue of the Hessian of the full training loss, without the decay term, by 20 power iterations with Hessian-vector products, warm started.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: lr_sharpness
meaning: Learning rate times sharpness. Gradient descent on a quadratic with this curvature is stable when it is below 2.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: weight_norm
meaning: Norm of all the parameters.
source: ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: param_dist
meaning: Relative parameter movement.
source: ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: log_weight_norm_ratio
meaning: Log of the weight norm over its value at step 0. The kernel of this 3-homogeneous network under a uniform rescaling of the weights by c is c^4 times larger, so four times this value is the scale term such a rescaling would give.
source: The group's own definition

name: W1_norm
meaning: Frobenius norm of W1.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: W1_dist
meaning: Relative movement of W1.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: W1_stable_rank
meaning: Stable rank of W1.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: W1_eff_rank
meaning: Effective rank of W1, the exponential of the entropy of the singular values normalised to sum to one.
formula: exp(-sum q log q), q = sigma / sum sigma
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: W2_norm
meaning: Frobenius norm of W2.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: W2_dist
meaning: Relative movement of W2.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: W2_stable_rank
meaning: Stable rank of W2.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: W2_eff_rank
meaning: Effective rank of W2, the exponential of the entropy of the singular values normalised to sum to one.
formula: exp(-sum q log q), q = sigma / sum sigma
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: W3_norm
meaning: Frobenius norm of W3.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: W3_dist
meaning: Relative movement of W3.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: W3_stable_rank
meaning: Stable rank of W3.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: W3_eff_rank
meaning: Effective rank of W3, the exponential of the entropy of the singular values normalised to sum to one.
formula: exp(-sum q log q), q = sigma / sum sigma
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: layer_imbalance_12
meaning: Difference of the squared norms of W1 and W2 over the squared total norm. Gradient flow without decay keeps ||W_l||^2 - ||W_(l+1)||^2 fixed for a bias-free ReLU network. With decay it shrinks by (1 - eta_kappa)^2 per step.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: layer_imbalance_23
meaning: Difference of the squared norms of W2 and W3 over the squared total norm. Gradient flow without decay keeps ||W_l||^2 - ||W_(l+1)||^2 fixed for a bias-free ReLU network. With decay it shrinks by (1 - eta_kappa)^2 per step.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: dead_frac_h1
meaning: Fraction of the units of hidden layer 1 that are inactive on every training image.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: active_frac_h1
meaning: Mean over training images of the fraction of the units of hidden layer 1 that are active.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: dead_frac_h2
meaning: Fraction of the units of hidden layer 2 that are inactive on every training image.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: active_frac_h2
meaning: Mean over training images of the fraction of the units of hidden layer 2 that are active.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: S_t
meaning: Scale term on the raw probe kernel.
source: ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: R_t
meaning: Rotation term on the raw probe kernel.
source: ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: K_norm
meaning: Frobenius norm of the raw probe kernel, the sum-over-outputs kernel.
source: ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: yKy
meaning: y^T K^+ y on the probe set, summed over the label columns.
source: ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: S_c
meaning: Scale term on the centred probe kernel.
source: docs/report.tex, Kernel metrics section. ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: R_c
meaning: Rotation term on the centred probe kernel.
source: docs/report.tex, Kernel metrics section. ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: A_t
meaning: Centred kernel-target alignment on the probe.
formula: <Kc_t, G> / (||Kc_t|| ||G||), G = H Y Y^T H
source: Cortes, Mohri and Rostamizadeh (2012), Definition 4. docs/report.tex, Kernel metrics section. ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: A_u
meaning: Uncentred alignment on the probe.
source: ntk_lib.uncentred_alignment. ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: S_c_train
meaning: The scale term on the train part of the probe, with the kernel restricted to those images.
source: docs/report.tex, Kernel metrics section. ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: R_c_train
meaning: The rotation term on the train part of the probe, with the kernel restricted to those images.
source: docs/report.tex, Kernel metrics section. ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: A_t_train
meaning: The centred alignment on the train part of the probe, with the kernel restricted to those images.
source: docs/report.tex, Kernel metrics section. ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: A_u_train
meaning: The uncentred alignment on the train part of the probe, with the kernel restricted to those images.
source: docs/report.tex, Kernel metrics section. ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: S_c_test
meaning: The scale term on the test part of the probe, with the kernel restricted to those images.
source: docs/report.tex, Kernel metrics section. ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: R_c_test
meaning: The rotation term on the test part of the probe, with the kernel restricted to those images.
source: docs/report.tex, Kernel metrics section. ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: A_t_test
meaning: The centred alignment on the test part of the probe, with the kernel restricted to those images.
source: docs/report.tex, Kernel metrics section. ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: A_u_test
meaning: The uncentred alignment on the test part of the probe, with the kernel restricted to those images.
source: docs/report.tex, Kernel metrics section. ntk_lib.train_run history, copied at the checkpoint

name: K_norm_centred
meaning: Frobenius norm of the centred probe kernel.
source: Cortes, Mohri and Rostamizadeh (2012), Lemma 1, for H K H

name: inner_K0
meaning: Inner product of the centred kernel with the centred kernel at step 0.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: inner_G
meaning: Inner product of the centred kernel with the centred target Gram matrix.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: D
meaning: The usual kernel movement statistic on the centred kernel.
source: docs/report.tex, Equation eq:decomp

name: exp2S_term
meaning: First piece of Equation eq:decomp. D^2 = exp2S_term + 1 - cross_term.
source: docs/report.tex, Equation eq:decomp, the group's own algebra

name: cross_term
meaning: Last piece of Equation eq:decomp.
source: docs/report.tex, Equation eq:decomp, the group's own algebra

name: gamma
meaning: The aim, the cosine between the part of k_t orthogonal to k_0 and the part of the unit target orthogonal to k_0. NaN at step 0.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: share_k0
meaning: Share of the squared change of the unit kernel along k_0. It equals R_c / 2.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: share_gperp
meaning: Share of the squared change of the unit kernel along g_perp.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: share_residual
meaning: Share of the squared change of the unit kernel orthogonal to both k_0 and g_perp. share_k0, share_gperp and share_residual sum to one.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: kernel_degenerate
meaning: True if the centred probe kernel norm is below 1e-30. The unit-kernel columns are then NaN.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: S_W1
meaning: Scale term of the centred kernel term from the gradient of W1 alone.
source: kernel_terms. The group's own definition

name: R_W1
meaning: Rotation term of the centred kernel term from W1 alone.
source: kernel_terms. The group's own definition

name: A_W1
meaning: Centred alignment of the kernel term from W1 alone.
source: kernel_terms. The group's own definition

name: W1_kernel_share
meaning: Share of the trace of the centred probe kernel that comes from W1.
source: kernel_terms. The group's own definition

name: S_W2
meaning: Scale term of the centred kernel term from the gradient of W2 alone.
source: kernel_terms. The group's own definition

name: R_W2
meaning: Rotation term of the centred kernel term from W2 alone.
source: kernel_terms. The group's own definition

name: A_W2
meaning: Centred alignment of the kernel term from W2 alone.
source: kernel_terms. The group's own definition

name: W2_kernel_share
meaning: Share of the trace of the centred probe kernel that comes from W2.
source: kernel_terms. The group's own definition

name: S_W3
meaning: Scale term of the centred kernel term from the gradient of W3 alone.
source: kernel_terms. The group's own definition

name: R_W3
meaning: Rotation term of the centred kernel term from W3 alone.
source: kernel_terms. The group's own definition

name: A_W3
meaning: Centred alignment of the kernel term from W3 alone.
source: kernel_terms. The group's own definition

name: W3_kernel_share
meaning: Share of the trace of the centred probe kernel that comes from W3.
source: kernel_terms. The group's own definition

name: S_first_logit
meaning: The scale term of the centred kernel of the first output alone. The report uses this kernel as a robustness check.
source: docs/report.tex, Kernel metrics section. kernel_terms

name: R_first_logit
meaning: The rotation term of the centred kernel of the first output alone. The report uses this kernel as a robustness check.
source: docs/report.tex, Kernel metrics section. kernel_terms

name: A_first_logit
meaning: The centred alignment of the centred kernel of the first output alone. The report uses this kernel as a robustness check.
source: docs/report.tex, Kernel metrics section. kernel_terms

name: S_sum
meaning: Scale, the plain ratio of Frobenius norms to step 0, of the kernel of the sum of the logits divided by sqrt(C), on a fixed draw of 1000 test images. These are the S_t, R_t, D_t and A_t of the golden report.
source: docs/report_golden.pdf, Equations 5 and 6. kernel_terms

name: R_sum
meaning: Shape change, one minus the uncentred cosine to step 0, of the kernel of the sum of the logits divided by sqrt(C), on a fixed draw of 1000 test images. These are the S_t, R_t, D_t and A_t of the golden report.
source: docs/report_golden.pdf, Equations 5 and 6. kernel_terms

name: D_sum
meaning: Variation, the Frobenius norm of the change from step 0 over the norm at step 0, of the kernel of the sum of the logits divided by sqrt(C), on a fixed draw of 1000 test images. These are the S_t, R_t, D_t and A_t of the golden report.
source: docs/report_golden.pdf, Equations 5 and 6. kernel_terms

name: A_sum
meaning: Centred alignment with Y Y^T, of the kernel of the sum of the logits divided by sqrt(C), on a fixed draw of 1000 test images. These are the S_t, R_t, D_t and A_t of the golden report.
source: docs/report_golden.pdf, Equations 5 and 6. kernel_terms

name: eig_trace
meaning: Trace of the centred probe kernel.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: eig_top1
meaning: Largest eigenvalue of the centred probe kernel.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: eig_top1_share
meaning: Largest eigenvalue over the trace.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: eig_eff_rank
meaning: Exponential of the entropy of the eigenvalues normalised to sum to one. The zero eigenvalue that centring creates is left out, and so is every column below.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: eig_participation
meaning: Participation ratio of the eigenvalues.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: eig_n90
meaning: Number of the largest eigenvalues that hold 90 percent of the trace.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: eig_gap_label
meaning: Ratio of eigenvalue 9 to eigenvalue 10, counting from one. The centred labels span 9 dimensions.
source: The group's own definition

name: eig_gap_top36
meaning: Ratio of eigenvalue 36 to eigenvalue 37, the edge of the eigenvectors that the tracking columns follow.
source: The group's own definition

name: probe_energy_label
meaning: Share of the trace of the centred probe kernel inside the centred label span on the probe.
formula: tr(Q^T Kc Q) / tr(Kc), Q an orthonormal basis of H Y
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: label_capture_9
meaning: Share of the centred label matrix inside the top 9 eigenvectors of the centred probe kernel.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: label_capture_18
meaning: Share of the centred label matrix inside the top 18 eigenvectors of the centred probe kernel.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: label_capture_36
meaning: Share of the centred label matrix inside the top 36 eigenvectors of the centred probe kernel.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: topk_drift
meaning: Mean squared sine of the principal angles between the span of the top 36 eigenvectors and the same span at step 0.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: overlap_zero_median
meaning: Median over the top 36 eigenvectors of the largest absolute overlap with any of the top 36 eigenvectors at step 0. dataset_features.py follows a chain of matches back to step 0 instead.
source: The group's own definition

name: krr_probe_test_acc
meaning: Accuracy of kernel ridge regression with the current probe kernel from the training part of the probe to its test part. The ridge is 0.001 times the mean diagonal of the training block.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: krr_probe_test_mse
meaning: Mean squared error of the same kernel ridge regression on the test part.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: dS_step
meaning: Change of the centred scale term over one virtual full-batch gradient step with decay at the current learning rate, in float64.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: dA_step
meaning: Change of the centred alignment over the same virtual step.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: R_step
meaning: Rotation of the centred unit kernel over the same virtual step.
source: repoduced-code/dataset_features.py, the same column for modular addition

name: run_id
meaning: The name of the run, run_id.

name: init_scale
meaning: The initial scale s.
source: Liu, Michaud and Tegmark (2023), Omnigrok, arXiv:2210.01117, Section 4

name: width
meaning: The width of both hidden layers.

name: eta_kappa
meaning: The weight decay per step, eta lambda.
source: docs/report.tex, The laziness and weight-decay knobs

name: seed
meaning: The model seed.

name: data_seed
meaning: The seed of the draw of the 1000 training images, 42 + seed.

name: n_train
meaning: The number of training images.

name: batch_size
meaning: The minibatch size.

name: lam_0

name: eta_0

name: status

name: error
meaning: The traceback of a failed run, empty otherwise.

name: diverged_step
meaning: The checkpoint at which the training loss was first not finite.

name: steps
meaning: The step budget.

name: last_step
meaning: The last recorded checkpoint.

name: n_checkpoints
meaning: The number of recorded checkpoints.

name: seconds
meaning: Wall-clock seconds for the run, logger included.

name: callback_seconds
meaning: Wall-clock seconds spent in the feature logger.

name: feature_version
meaning: mnist_features.FEATURE_VERSION when the run was made.

name: git_commit
meaning: The commit of the repository when the run was made.

name: git_dirty
meaning: True if mnist/ or ntk_lib.py had uncommitted changes when the run was made.

meaning: Largest relative difference between the autograd and closed-form kernels on 32 probe images at the first and last checkpoints.

meaning: Weight norm at step 0.

name: final_weight_norm
meaning: Weight norm at the last checkpoint.

name: weight_norm_growth
meaning: final_weight_norm / init_weight_norm.

name: final_lr_factor
meaning: The learning rate at the last checkpoint over eta_0.

name: A_t_final
meaning: A_t at the last checkpoint.

name: S_c_final
meaning: S_c at the last checkpoint.

name: R_c_final
meaning: R_c at the last checkpoint.

name: S_sum_final
meaning: S_sum at the last checkpoint.

name: R_sum_final
meaning: R_sum at the last checkpoint.

name: D_sum_final
meaning: D_sum at the last checkpoint.

name: A_sum_final
meaning: A_sum at the last checkpoint.

name: train_acc_final
meaning: train_acc at the last checkpoint.

name: test_acc_final
meaning: test_acc at the last checkpoint.

name: train_loss_final
meaning: train_loss at the last checkpoint.

meaning: test_loss at the last checkpoint.

name: A_0
meaning: A_t at step 0.

name: A_peak

name: A_peak_step
meaning: The step of A_peak.

name: A_min
meaning: Smallest A_t over the run.

meaning: The step of A_min.

name: best_test_acc

name: best_test_step
meaning: The step of best_test_acc.

name: memorised
meaning: True if the training accuracy reached 0.99 at some checkpoint. A run that never memorises has no grokking time, which is different from a censored one.

name: t_mem
meaning: First checkpoint at which the training accuracy is at least 0.99.
source: docs/report_golden.pdf, section 3.5

name: t_mem_prev
meaning: The checkpoint before t_mem. The event lies in (t_mem_prev, t_mem].

name: t_mem100
meaning: First checkpoint at which the training accuracy is 1, the memorisation of dataset_sweep.py.

name: test_acc_at_mem
meaning: Test accuracy at t_mem.

name: t_gen_acc50
meaning: First checkpoint at which the test accuracy reaches 0.5, counted from step 0.

name: t_gen_acc50_prev
meaning: The checkpoint before t_gen_acc50.

name: t_grok_acc50
meaning: Grokking time at test level 0.5: t_gen_acc50 - t_mem, or last_step - t_mem if censored. Empty if the run never memorised. Negative if the level came before memorisation.

name: censored_acc50

name: t_gen_acc60
meaning: First checkpoint at which the test accuracy reaches 0.6, counted from step 0.

name: t_gen_acc60_prev
